connector.name: OptionsBell Options Flow
connector.registryDescription: Unusual options activity on 7,000+ US stocks: top prints, streaks, IV rank, sentiment, sectors.
connector.summary: Hosted at optionsbell.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.optionsbell, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your OptionsBell API key (sms_...). Generate at https://optionsbell.com/settings - requires an active subscription. Alternatively connect via a personal connector URL from Settings, which needs no header at all.
